headline: 10 mainnet contracts catalogued on Ink (Clearinghouse, Endpoint, SpotEngine, PerpEngine, OffchainExchange, WithdrawPool, Verifier, Querier, Quote, Deployer EOA); multisig admin address not yet surfaced.

findings.text: D1: Ink block explorer (explorer.inkonchain.com) fetched for Deployer (0xC1cC56caB60e832665E6c3780BfEBe3C1C971603) and Clearinghouse (0xD218103918C19D0A10cf35300E4CfAfbD444c5fE); Blockscout pages confirmed these addresses exist on Ink chain. Explorer is JS-rendered so only metadata returned; full on-chain reads require DeFiPunkd API with Ink chainId (57073) not currently supported — recorded in unknowns.

D2: Official deployments doc at https://docs.nado.xyz/more/contracts fetched successfully. Lists 10 mainnet contracts with addresses and roles on Ink, plus 10 testnet contracts on Ink Sepolia. All addresses extracted. Docs also note a multisig owns ContractOwner (full admin authority) but do not publish the multisig address.

D3: No audit_links provided in protocol context. Search and HackenProof fetch confirm no published formal audit reports from named firms. HackenProof page is a live bug bounty program (not an audit). Recorded in unknowns.

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/nadohq/nado-contracts fetched. Public repo under nadohq org with core/ directory containing Solidity contracts. No pinned commit SHA available from the repo root page fetch (commit history shown but no specific SHA surfaced in metadata). No deployment artifacts (broadcast JSON or hardhat-deploy JSON) found at repo root — would need to walk core/ subdirectory.
D5: Protocol operates on Ink chain only (confirmed DeFiLlama: 100% TVL on Ink). Single-chain enumeration completed. No cross-chain deployments.

D6: No factory contract identified in the address table. SpotEngine and PerpEngine manage product state but are not pool factories. DeFiPunkd read API does not support Ink chainId (57073) so factory child enumeration via read API not possible this run.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: Deployer=EOA/owner, Quote=token, Querier=other, Clearinghouse=vault (top-level accounting), Endpoint=router (sequencer gateway), OffchainExchange=other (order settlement), SpotEngine=pool (spot state machine), PerpEngine=pool (perp state machine), Verifier=other (EIP-712 signer), WithdrawPool=vault (fast-withdraw reserve). Multisig (ContractOwner owner) not yet surfaced.

D8: All 10 admin_addresses entries trace to fetched URL https://docs.nado.xyz/more/contracts. Ink explorer fetches for two addresses confirm they are known to the explorer. No snippet-only sightings promoted to admin_addresses.

rationale.verdict: Walked official docs (docs.nado.xyz/more/contracts), GitHub (nadohq/nado-contracts), Ink block explorer, HackenProof bug bounty page, and DeFiLlama. Catalogued 10 mainnet contracts on Ink. Grade remains unknown because (a) the multisig address holding full admin authority was not published and could not be surfaced, (b) Ink chainId (57073) is not supported by the DeFiPunkd read API so on-chain view reads could not be performed, and (c) no formal audit reports were found.

DeFiLlama entry for Nado Spot: $54.44M TVL on Ink, categorized as DEX. Protocol described as 'vertically-integrated decentralized exchange for spot and perpetual futures, featuring an off-chain sequencer and on-chain settlement on Ink.' Operates exclusively on Ink chain.

admin_addresses.role: owner (Deployer EOA — narrow onlyDeployer role on ContractOwner for routine config; full admin belongs to multisig)
vault (Clearinghouse — top-level accounting, deposit/withdrawal routing, insurance fund, sole authority to mutate engine balances)
router (Endpoint — sequencer transaction gateway, EIP-712 validation, nonce and subaccount registry)
other (OffchainExchange — order settlement against engines, per-market fee/sizing config, filled-amount tracking)
pool (SpotEngine — per-product state machine for spot markets, deposit/borrow tracking, interest accrual)
pool (PerpEngine — per-product state machine for perpetual futures, positions and funding tracking)
other (Verifier — EIP-712 signature verifier with aggregated-pubkey support for user-signed transactions)
vault (WithdrawPool — token reserve for fast withdrawals)

protocol_metadata.about: Nado is a vertically-integrated CLOB (central-limit orderbook) DEX on Ink L2, supporting spot and perpetual futures trading through a unified cross-margin account. Users deposit USDT0 as collateral and trade via an off-chain matching engine (5–15ms latency) with on-chain settlement enforced by the Clearinghouse, SpotEngine, and PerpEngine contracts. The protocol also features an NLP (Nado Liquidity Provider) vault where users can provide liquidity as counterparty to traders. Built by the team behind Kraken exchange and deployed exclusively on the Ink chain (Optimistic Rollup on Ethereum).
